title: Foodweb guild × depth-bin initial biomass + carrying capacity
description: Per (guild × depth bin) initial conditions and carrying capacity for the MIMES marine foodweb: min/max biomass (kg/m²), depth likelihood, IC_Biomass (with + without migrants), carrying capacity. Joined to the 7 depth-bin (M_EBIN_ID 1..7) structure used throughout the model.
